standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the morphism from the S_0-algebra structure on the structure sheaf.

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard open algebra maps
standard_prerequisites.use: S to S_f and S_(f) to S_f are S_0-algebra maps.

core_obligations: The construction of S-tilde gives a sheaf of S_0-algebras; the morphism into the affine Spec(S_0) exists by the named lemma.
Restricted to D_+(f) the morphism comes from the canonical ring map S_0 to S_(f).
The homogeneous prime p, its localization image p prime and its degree-zero prime p double-prime all have the same contraction to S_0, matching the topological map.
proof_roadmap: Build the morphism, restrict to charts, and verify the prime contractions coincide.
difficulty_reason: Morphism-into-affine construction with the prime-contraction compatibility check; fully displayed.
